name: theme-sisc
industry: education — private international school and college

source.engagement: Campus Electrical Network Integration and Smart Energy Management Project
source.deckAuthor: Argeo T. Alecha, Electrical Engineering Consultant
source.method: OOXML unpack — crest raster quantised in HSL, slide srgbClr frequency ranked across 24 slides, typeface and prstGeom census
source.reconfirmedAgainst: southville-electric-docs/Plans and Deliverables/Project_Plan_Details.pptx (created 2026-09-03, MD5 73fa2bb6f2fc68a7a9c17d128cdb8d45) — same 24 slides, same PptxGenJS authorship, same font census; no palette or type changes

a11ySafeText.note: Use these in place of the display values when the color carries small body text (<18pt regular / <14pt bold). Verified >=4.5:1 against background, surface and card.

typography.displayFontNote: Statement/accent face only — 5 runs across slides 4-6 of the source deck. Arial carries titles at every other size. Do not set all headings in Georgia.
typography.bodyFontNote: The deck face — 1,272 of 1,290 runs, used for body AND most titles (18pt through 54pt).

webSubstitutes.note: Georgia, Arial and Courier New are system fonts, not webfonts. Arimo, Gelasio and Cousine are the metric-compatible Google-hosted equivalents — same advance widths, so layout does not reflow when they substitute.

deckScalePt.note: Corrected 2026-09-04 by per-run census. 18pt is a hard floor — the deck contains no smaller type. All sizes are Arial except statementTitle (Georgia) and the slides 4-5 variant of slideTitle.

conventions.kicker: Arial bold 18pt uppercase. Default: muted #7C6F75, letter-spacing +2.88pt (18 runs). Emphasis: accent #D2650F, letter-spacing +1.8pt.
conventions.sectionHead: Arial bold 24pt — accent #D2650F letterspaced +0.96pt, or text #1E181B
conventions.statementTitle: Georgia bold 42-48pt — section-opening statements only, white on a filled ground or #410BDB on light
conventions.divider: 17.83in x 0.02in bar in primaryLit #6A3D9E under the title; #B589D6 on statement slides; title slide uses a short 2.92in x 0.04in rule
conventions.footerBand: 17.83in x 0.89in band at y=9.53 filled tintBlush #F6D6DC — uppercase label plus a middot-separated list
conventions.cards: 3-up, 5.69 x 3.53in, gutter 0.38in, fill background #FFF8F9, 0.05in top accent bar in a different color per card (#AE1029 / #D2650F / #6A3D9E). No border, no shadow.
conventions.nestedSquares: Three concentric unfilled squares top-right: 2.43in at (16.90,0.58), 1.70in at (17.27,0.95), 0.97in at (17.63,1.31)

radiiRationale: sharp — the deck uses 509 rect shapes and 27 ellipses, zero roundRect

shadows._note: WEB OUTPUT ONLY. The source deck contains zero shadow/effect declarations and is deliberately flat — never apply these to a slide or document.

logo.realAssetNote: logo.png is the client's actual horizontal lockup (badge + single-line wordmark), supplied by the user on 2026-08-19 as a screenshot — not the low-res crest embedded in the pptx. logo-dark.png is a programmatic recolor of that same real asset (HSL-masked: flat blush background swapped to primary-800 #221433, wordmark violet swapped to primary-300 #B49ED1; the badge's own pixels are untouched — it carries a self-contained white card). The .svg files are hand-redrawn approximations of this real layout for use cases needing a vector — they are NOT a trace of the official crest.
logo.description: Heraldic shield crest — violet shield, purple name banner across the top in white type, white inner field, quartered diamond (violet star canton with 5 stars, maroon heart canton, green globe-with-figures base), motto FACITE DIFFERENTIAM in small type across the diamond seam, green laurel wreath, founding year 1990 at the base. Paired with a single-line serif small-caps wordmark in primaryLit violet.
